what: P3 of the Lean fidelity + intake plan (the operator's pick, 2026-11-09): one fresh outside claim end to end with the tool built in P1–P2, timed. The claim: google-deepmind/formal-conjectures PR #5299 (Declan Gessel with GPT-6 Astra in Codex, opened 2026-09-06, approved three times, unmerged), linking an external Lean refutation of Erdős #786(i). Its file states its OWN copies of IsMulCardSet and HasDensity; the PR says they match the module's. F1 decides that: the kernel must accept the proof against DeepMind's declaration as it stands on main today (the statement changed on 2026-10-14, after the PR: the `answer(sorry) ↔` wrapper was removed). This spec is the pre-registration, committed before any run.

claim.what: Declan Gessel's refutation of Erdős #786(i), with OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra in Codex (google-deepmind/formal-conjectures PR #5299)
claim.license: Apache-2.0 (the repository's); the file is still not copied into this repository — the run fetches it at the pin

canonical.what: DeepMind's statement of Erdős #786(i) on main

expectF1: CERTIFIED if the claimant's definitions unfold to DeepMind's (the PR's claim); REFUSED with the mismatch otherwise

f3.what: a model of the canonical statement's hypotheses: ε = 1/2
f3.tactic:
intro h
  exact h (1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

f2NotApplicable: the statement quantifies over a real ε and over infinite sets A through a limit (natural density): no finite instance decides any of its parts, so F2 is refused, not run
